description: This file defines the vardefs (variable definitions) for the 'jjwg_Markers' module in a SugarCRM / SuiteCRM extension. It specifies the database table, fields, relationships, and module options for the marker entity, including fields like city, state, country, latitude, longitude, and marker image.

methods.name: VardefManager::createVardef
methods.description: Creates vardef metadata for the specified module with given options.
